# SINT (State · Injection · Navigation · Translation) — v2.3.0 LLM Reference

> Extreme-performance, Clean Architecture micro-framework for Flutter (`>=3.47.0`, Dart `^3.13.0`).
> Battle-tested in production across Open Neom's `70+` modular packages (Audio DAW/DSP, 3D/VR + Flutter GPU, 256 Hz EEG streams, on-device LLM streaming, and Web/Wasm suites).
> Repository: https://github.com/Open-Neom/sint
> Pub package: https://pub.dev/packages/sint

SINT replaces legacy GetX internals with a strict 4-pillar architecture (`S · I · N · T`), reified `Type`-keyed DI (safe under Web/Wasm minification), single-element `MultiBinder` (`O(1)` widget depth), zero-allocation single-slot `Obx`/`ObxSelect`/`Computed` signals, VSync-aligned `Sint.frameBatch` & `FrameThrottledRx`, a multi-level literal prefix trie router, reactive `O(1)` localization, an automated migration CLI (`dart run sint:migrate`), and built-in runtime diagnostics (`Sint.diagnostics` / `ext.sint.*`).

## Critical Rules for AI Coding Assistants

1. **Import only `package:sint/sint.dart`** (or `package:sint/rx.dart` for headless Dart/isolate reactive models) — Never generate `GetConnect`, HTTP clients, or string validators from `sint`.
2. **Use `Sint*` symbols, NOT `@Deprecated` `Get*` aliases**:
   - `Sint` (not `Get`), `SintController` (not `GetxController`), `SintService` (not `GetxService`)
   - `SintApp` (preferred standalone `material_ui`/`cupertino_ui` host) or `SintMaterialApp` / `SintCupertinoApp` (never `GetMaterialApp`)
   - `SintPage` (not `GetPage`), `SintView<T>` (not `GetView<T>`), `SintBuilder<T>` (not `GetBuilder<T>`), `SintRouterOutlet` (not `GetRouterOutlet`)
   - Use `initialRoute:` + `sintPages:` (never the deprecated `home:` parameter or `getPages:`).
3. **Contract-First Clean Architecture DI (`Bind.contract`)**:
   - When binding an abstract interface `AuthService` implemented by `AuthController extends SintController implements AuthService`, ALWAYS use a single `Bind.contract<AuthService, AuthController>(() => AuthController(), fenix: true)` (or `Sint.contract` / `Sint.putContract` / `Sint.putContractAsync`).
   - NEVER pass a factory closure to `Bind.put(() => MyController())` — `Bind.put` takes an instance (`Bind.put(MyController())`); use `Bind.lazyPut(() => MyController())` for factories.
4. **Fine-Grained & High-Frequency Signals (`Obx`, `ObxSelect`, `Computed`, `Sint.batch`, `Sint.frameBatch`, `FrameThrottledRx`)**:
   - Mutate multiple reactive fields synchronously inside `Sint.batch(() { ... })` to coalesce downstream `Computed` and `Obx` rebuilds into a single pass.
   - For high-frequency streams (>60 Hz: audio DSP, EEG, VR poses, WebSockets, LLM token streams), wrap mutations in `Sint.frameBatch(() { ... })` or expose `late final uiValue = frameThrottled(rawRx)` inside `SintController` (auto-disposed on `onClose()`).
   - Use `ObxSelect<T>(selector: () => model.value.slice, builder: (v) => ...)` to observe a single field of a complex `Rx<Model>` without declaring extra `Computed` fields.
   - Read `.peek` (or `Sint.untrack(...)`) inside controller methods/mutators when you do NOT want to register a reactive dependency.
5. **Overlays vs. Page Navigation**:
   - ALWAYS dismiss dialogs and bottom sheets with **`Sint.pop([result])`** (never `Sint.back()`, which pops page routes).
   - Never call `Navigator.*` directly in SINT apps; use `Sint.toNamed`, `Sint.offNamed`, `Sint.back`, `Sint.maybePop`, `Sint.canPop`, and `Sint.pop`.

---

## Pillar S — State Management & Real-Time Telemetry

```dart
class TelemetryController extends SintController {
  final qty = 1.obs;
  final unitPrice = 25.0.obs;
  final rawEegSample = 0.0.obs;

  late final subtotal = computed(() => qty.value * unitPrice.value); // Glitch-free diamond signal (optional `lazy: true`)
  late final uiEeg = frameThrottled(rawEegSample); // Coalesced to 1 emit/VSync, auto-disposed on onClose()
  late final orderStatus = rxFuture(() => api.fetchOrder());

  @override
  void onInit() {
    super.onInit();
    ever<int>(qty, (next) => Sint.log('Qty changed: $next'));
    everAll([qty, unitPrice], (_) => Sint.log('Pricing inputs updated'));
  }

  void applyBundle() => Sint.batch(() {
    qty.value += 2;
    unitPrice.value = 20.0;
  });

  // Safe to invoke at 256–1000 Hz from FFI/DSP/LLM callbacks:
  void onSensorSample(double v) => Sint.frameBatch(() {
    rawEegSample.value = v;
  });
}
```

- **Widgets**:
  - `Obx(() => Text('${c.subtotal.value}'), debugLabel: 'subtotal')` — Zero-allocation single-slot fast path for 1-signal widgets; automatic conditional branch pruning; tracks `.obs`, `Computed`, `FrameThrottledRx`, external `ValueListenable.rxValue`, and `.tr`.
  - `ObxSelect<String>(selector: () => c.user.value.name, equals: ..., builder: (name) => Text(name), debugLabel: 'user-name')` — Fine-grained inline selector widget honoring `SintScope` and `Sint.diagnostics`.
  - `SintView<TelemetryController>` — Typed `StatelessWidget` with `controller` getter (automatically honors `SintScope`).
  - Exhaustive async UI via Dart 3 `SintStatus<T>` pattern matching:
    ```dart
    Obx(() => switch (c.orderStatus.value) {
      LoadingStatus(:final previousData) when previousData != null => ContentView(previousData, refreshing: true),
      LoadingStatus() => const CircularProgressIndicator(),
      SuccessStatus(:final data) => ContentView(data),
      EmptyStatus() => const EmptyPlaceholder(),
      ErrorStatus(:final error, :final stackTrace) => ErrorBanner('$error', stackTrace: stackTrace, onRetry: c.orderStatus.reload),
    })
    ```
- **Collections (`RxList`, `RxMap`, `RxSet`)**:
  - Default `RxList()`, `RxMap()`, `RxSet()` are mutable; `assign` and `assignAll` short-circuit with `0` notifications when contents are unchanged.

---

## Pillar I — Dependency Injection & Scoped Testing

```dart
// Declarative root or route-level DI (flattened into 1 MultiBinder Element):
Binds(
  binds: [
    Bind.put<LoggerService>(LoggerService()), // SintService => permanent: true by default
    Bind.contract<AuthService, AuthController>(
      () => AuthController(),
      aliases: [SessionManageable],
      fenix: true,
    ),
  ],
  child: child,
)
```

- **Imperative & Async DI**:
  - `Sint.put<T>(instance)`, `Sint.lazyPut<T>(() => ..., fenix: true)`
  - `Sint.contract<S, I>(() => I(), tag: 'v2', isDefault: true, aliases: [...])`
  - `Sint.putContract<S, I>(instance)` / `await Sint.putContractAsync<S, I>(() async => ...)`
  - `Sint.find<S>()`, `Sint.findOrNull<S>()`, `Sint.findOrPut<S>(() => ...)`, `Sint.findAll<S>()`, `Sint.findAt<S>(0)` (NEVER write `Sint.isRegistered<T>() ? Sint.find<T>() : null` or `try { Sint.find<T>() } catch` — use `Sint.findOrNull<T>()` or `Sint.findOrPut<T>(() => ...)`!)
- **Scoped Overrides (`SintScope` for Widget Subtrees & Unit Tests)**:
  ```dart
  await SintScope.run(
    overrides: [
      SintOverride.contract<AuthService, FakeAuthController>(() => FakeAuthController()),
    ],
    body: () async {
      expect(Sint.find<AuthService>().isLoggedIn, isTrue);
    },
  );
  ```

---

## Pillar N — Navigation, Typed Routes & Middlewares

```dart
const profileRoute = SintRoute<ProfileArgs, bool>('/profile/:id');

final app = SintApp(
  materialTheme: ThemeData(),
  initialRoute: '/',
  globalMiddlewares: [AuthGuard()],
  binds: [
    Bind.contract<AuthService, AuthController>(() => AuthController(), fenix: true),
  ],
  sintPages: [
    SintPage(name: '/', page: () => const HomePage()),
    profileRoute.page(
      binds: [Bind.lazyPut(() => ProfileController())],
      page: () => const ProfilePage(),
    ),
  ],
);

final saved = await profileRoute.to(
  arguments: const ProfileArgs(tab: 1),
  pathParams: {'id': '42'},
  queryParams: {'ref': 'feed'},
);
```

- **Page navigation**: `Sint.toNamed('/path')`, `Sint.offNamed('/path')`, `Sint.offNamedUntil('/path', predicate)`, `Sint.offAndToNamed('/path')`, `Sint.offAllNamed('/login')`, `Sint.to(() => Page())`, `Sint.off(() => Page())`, `Sint.until(predicate)`, `Sint.back(result: true)`, `Sint.maybePop(result)`, `Sint.canPop`, and typed `profileRoute.uri(...)` / `profileRoute.offAndTo(...)`.
- **Overlays**: `Sint.dialog<T>(widget)`, `Sint.bottomSheet<T>(widget)`, `Sint.snackbar(title, msg)` — ALWAYS dismiss dialogs/sheets with `Sint.pop([result])`.
- **Route Arguments & Parameters**: Prefer `Sint.argumentsAs<MyArgs>()` (returns `null` safely on type mismatch or headless tests) instead of unsafe `Sint.arguments as MyArgs`; `Sint.parameters`, `Sint.pathParams`, and `Sint.queryParams` safely return empty maps when `SintRoot` is unmounted.
- **Middlewares (`SintMiddleware`)**: Override synchronous `RouteSettings? redirect(String? route)` or async `Future<RouteDecoder?> redirectDelegate(RouteDecoder route)`. Enforced before stack mutation across all navigation methods.

---

## Pillar T — Reactive Localization (`O(1)` Lookup)

```dart
// Reactive inside Obx, ObxSelect, and Computed — automatically updates on Sint.updateLocale!
Obx(() => Text('welcome_user'.trParams({'name': user.name.value})))

Sint.registerLazyTranslations('fr_FR', () => loadFrenchDictionary());
await Sint.updateLocale(const Locale('fr', 'FR')); // Zero performReassemble() overhead
```

- Plural keys resolve `_zero` / `_other` automatically via `'item_count'.trPluralParams('item_count_plural', count, {'count': '$count'})`.
- Missing key telemetry hook: `Sint.onMissingTranslationKey = (key, locale) => ...`.

---

## Diagnostics (`Sint.diagnostics`), Migration (`sint:migrate`) & Linter (`sint:audit`)

```dart
// Zero-overhead in release; opt-in rebuild hot-spot tracking in debug/profile:
Sint.diagnostics.enableRebuildTracking = true;
Sint.diagnostics.onRebuild = (label, count) { /* e.g. sint_sentinel StateWatchdog */ };
final hotSpots = Sint.diagnostics.rebuildStats(); // Map<String, int> sorted descending
final snapshot = Sint.diagnostics.snapshot();     // Unified 4-pillar JSON snapshot
```

- VM Service Extensions registered automatically in `!kReleaseMode`: `ext.sint.getSnapshot`, `ext.sint.getDependencies`, `ext.sint.getRoutes`, `ext.sint.getLocalization`, `ext.sint.getRebuildStats`.
- Built-in CLI tools:
  - `dart run sint:migrate . --dry-run` / `--apply` (migrates `pubspec.yaml` + GetX symbols)
  - `dart run sint:audit . --fail-on-warnings --strict --json` (read-only 10-rule architectural linter for CI)
